input.content:
You are an expert OOP programming teacher who creates coding challenges for a multiplayer game. You generate tasks that teach object-oriented programming concepts through hands-on coding.

RULES:
- Tasks should be solvable in 2-5 minutes
- Starter code should have clear TODOs marking what to fix
- The solution must be complete and runnable
- Validation patterns must be literal code fragments from the solution
- Keep code concise (under 30 lines)
- Generate DIFFERENT scenarios each time (not always Dog/Animal or BankAccount)
- Use creative class names like Vehicle/ElectricCar, Weapon/Sword, Shape/Hexagon, etc.
- Visible checks should be written as plain English specs
- Validation patterns should be exact code fragments from the solution

Generate a single_responsibility coding task in javascript.

Language syntax reference:
JavaScript OOP:
- Class: class Animal { constructor(name) { this.name = name; } speak() { return this.name; } }
- Inheritance: class Dog extends Animal { constructor(name) { super(name); } }
- Private: use #field syntax or closures. Use #balance for private fields.
- Polymorphism: override methods in subclass, no keyword needed

The task should teach the concept of single_responsibility through a creative, original scenario (don't use Animal/Dog or BankAccount — pick something unique and fun).

content.title: Refactor PlayerCharacter for Single Responsibility
content.prompt: The 'PlayerCharacter' class currently handles both its core character attributes and its inventory management, violating the Single Responsibility Principle. Your task is to refactor the code by extracting all inventory-related logic into a new 'InventoryManager' class. The 'PlayerCharacter' should then use an instance of 'InventoryManager' to delegate these responsibilities.
content.starter_code: class Item { constructor(name) { this.name = name; } } class PlayerCharacter { constructor(name, health) { this.name = name; this.health = health; this.items = []; // TODO: This array should be managed by a separate class } pickUpItem(item) { this.items.push(item); // TODO: Delegate this method to InventoryManager return `${this.name} picked up ${item.name}.`; } dropItem(itemName) { const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item.name === itemName); if (index > -1) { const droppedItem = this.items.splice(index, 1)[0]; // TODO: Delegate this method to InventoryManager return `${this.name} dropped ${droppedItem.name}.`; } return `${this.name} does not have ${itemName}.`; } consumeItem(itemName) { const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item.name === itemName); if (index > -1) { const consumedItem = this.items.splice(index, 1)[0]; // TODO: Delegate this method to InventoryManager return `${this.name} consumed ${consumedItem.name}.`; } return `${this.name} does not have ${itemName}.`; } listItems() { if (this.items.length === 0) { return `${this.name}'s inventory is empty.`; } return `${this.name}'s items: ${this.items.map(item => item.name).join(', ')}.`; // TODO: Delegate this method to InventoryManager } takeDamage(amount) { this.health -= amount; return `${this.name} took ${amount} damage. Health: ${this.health}.`; } }
content.solution_code: class Item { constructor(name) { this.name = name; } } class InventoryManager { constructor() { this.items = []; } addItem(item) { this.items.push(item); return `picked up ${item.name}.`; } dropItem(itemName) { const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item.name === itemName); if (index > -1) { const droppedItem = this.items.splice(index, 1)[0]; return `dropped ${droppedItem.name}.`; } return `does not have ${itemName}.`; } consumeItem(itemName) { const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item.name === itemName); if (index > -1) { const consumedItem = this.items.splice(index, 1)[0]; return `consumed ${consumedItem.name}.`; } return `does not have ${itemName}.`; } listItems() { if (this.items.length === 0) { return `inventory is empty.`; } return `items: ${this.items.map(item => item.name).join(', ')}.`; } } class PlayerCharacter { constructor(name, health) { this.name = name; this.health = health; this.inventory = new InventoryManager(); } pickUpItem(item) { return `${this.name} ${this.inventory.addItem(item)}`; } dropItem(itemName) { return `${this.name} ${this.inventory.dropItem(itemName)}`; } consumeItem(itemName) { return `${this.name} ${this.inventory.consumeItem(itemName)}`; } listItems() { return `${this.name}'s ${this.inventory.listItems()}`; } takeDamage(amount) { this.health -= amount; return `${this.name} took ${amount} damage. Health: ${this.health}.`; } }
visible_checks: The PlayerCharacter class no longer directly stores or manages an array of items.
A new InventoryManager class has been created, solely responsible for all item-related operations.
PlayerCharacter delegates all inventory actions (pick up, drop, consume, list) to its InventoryManager instance.
